name: Aster
source:
They/Him/Any

Sent to the house by your sister to check on her cat, Aster is unlike anyone you've ever met. He's charming and kind, but the mystery behind his connection to you may be the only one that truly matters anymore.

"I'm being honest, she did persuade me in part by the idea that I might get to meet you…I'm finding it to have been very worthy of my time."

[From [url=https://shewassaying.itch.io/titanarum]itch.io[/url]]
